messages.content: Ongoing: RoboRide drops price to $0.12 per mile. Wait time now 8 minutes. Coverage expanded to residential areas. Partnership wit
You notice more robotaxis on the streets. About 7% of people seem to be using them regularly.

The school board voted yes. Mark Thompson received written confirmation from the board secretary this tick that the Millfield Auto Tech Pipeline has approved funding and an equipment budget line — the culmination of twelve ticks of coalition-building. He immediately contacted the community college articulation contact Santos had referred him to and scheduled the first formal meeting, then texted Sarah Kim two date options for her classroom guest session; she confirmed the Thursday hybrid diagnostics session within the hour. Thompson walked into the community center and handed Lisa Freeman a one-page program flyer for the referral pipeline, and the two agreed in writing that the Navigator and the Pipeline would cross-refer the same population from different entry points. He also completed a two-page articulation agreement framework draft to bring to the CC meeting — prepared enough that the meeting will be productive rather than introductory.
